reference: She had been crying for twenty minutes before the therapy really began.
sk: Plakala dvadsať minút, kým sa terapia naozaj začala.
cz: Plakala dvacet minut, než terapie opravdu začala.
acceptable: She had been crying for twenty minutes before {the |}therapy {really|actually|properly} {began|started}.

mistakes.text: She cried for twenty minutes before the therapy really began.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dlhší dej pred iným minulým dejom zdôrazní Past Perfect Continuous: „had been crying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Delší děj před jiným minulým dějem zdůrazní Past Perfect Continuous: „had been crying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect Continuous stresses a longer action before another past event: “had been crying”.

mistakes.text: She had cried for twenty minutes before the therapy really began.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri trvaní („for twenty minutes“) je prirodzenejší Past Perfect Continuous: „had been crying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U trvání („for twenty minutes“) je přirozenější Past Perfect Continuous: „had been crying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With a duration like “for twenty minutes”, Past Perfect Continuous “had been crying” is more natural.

mistakes.text: She was crying for twenty minutes before the therapy really began.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Continuous nevyjadrí trvanie až po iný minulý dej; treba „had been crying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Continuous nevyjádří trvání až do jiného minulého děje; je potřeba „had been crying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Continuous can't show duration up to another past event; use “had been crying”.

mistakes.text: She has been crying for twenty minutes before the therapy really began.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Všetko sa odohralo v minulosti, preto Past Perfect Continuous: „had been crying“, nie „has“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Vše se odehrálo v minulosti, proto Past Perfect Continuous: „had been crying“, ne „has“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Everything is in the past, so use Past Perfect Continuous: “had been crying”, not “has”.

mistakes.text: She had been crying since twenty minutes before the therapy really began.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dĺžke trvania patrí „for“, nie „since“: „for twenty minutes“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U délky trvání patří „for“, ne „since“: „for twenty minutes“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “for” with a length of time, not “since”: “for twenty minutes”.
